# Weatherproof Vintage

> > Weatherproof Vintage offers classic American casual wear and outerwear featuring Weather Wash technology, sherpa-lined jackets, linen shirts, and vintage-inspired menswear and womenswear.

Weatherproof Vintage specializes in comfortable, durable clothing with a vintage aesthetic, including signature sherpa-lined shackets, fleece-lined jeans, and breathable linen pieces. The brand emphasizes classic fits, casual styling, and weather-appropriate fabrics for year-round wear.

## Key Topics

- Weather Wash technology
- Sherpa-lined outerwear
- Classic fit clothing
- Linen shirts
- Fleece-lined jeans
- Shackets (shirt jackets)
- Casual menswear
- Vintage-inspired apparel
- Corduroy clothing
- Puffer vests
- Flannel overshirts
- Cashmere sweaters
- Resort wear
- Machine washable fabrics
- Layering pieces
